inputs.text: Health sector workers protested at Unity Fountain in Maitama, Abuja, on Thursday, opposing controversial reform bills before the National Assembly. The protest involved the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations and came amid escalating tensions in the sector.
